name: Animantarx
sum: Animantarx is a small nodosaurid from the Cedar Mountain Formation of Utah, a slow-moving armoured herbivore without a tail club.
wsnote: Upper limit inferred from a skull about 25 cm long (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: A lower jaw and back half of the skull, neck and back vertebrae and limb elements — Cedar Mountain Formation, Utah.
biology: A slow-moving quadrupedal herbivore covered in heavy armour scutes, without a tail club.
author: Carpenter et al. 1999

images.caption: Skull of Animantarx in a museum.
